description.narrative: Project seeks to equip 85 young women leaders—5 from each of Nairobi's 17 sub-counties including PWDs—with knowledge and support to become effective advocates for gender-responsive budgeting. The project will deliver intensive training forums, empowering participants with critical budget literacy skills. The short-term impact includes enhanced budget literacy and advocacy skills among the 85 young women leaders, leading to increased participation and visibility of informed women's voices in budget consultation forums. In the long term, this project aims to foster more gender-responsive budget allocations and policies in Nairobi City County, ultimately addressing existing inequalities and promoting women's economic empowerment. By building a network of empowered young women advocates, this initiative seeks to create sustainable change in governance, promoting a more inclusive and equitable development trajectory for Nairobi, aligning to Ireland’s commitment to leave no one behind and support locally led action.
